sources.title: Enecom October 1 notice to Hiroshima Data Center customers
sources.summary: Dated operator notice addresses continuing customers of the named Hiroshima data center and publishes its housing, cabling and managed-service terms. Supports existing service continuity as of publication, not an opening, construction event or occupancy claim. The renewable-power option is prospective from April 2027.

sources.title: Hiroshima Data Center housing terms and explicit EneWings name change
sources.summary: Printed page 36 explicitly renames EneWings Hiroshima Data Center to Hiroshima Data Center effective October 1, 2026, while retaining preexisting contract conditions. This establishes service-name continuity. Effective dates are not source publication or facility-opening dates.

sources.title: Enecom joint September 18 distributed-DC demonstration release
sources.summary: Joint participant release states the demonstration began in August 2026. Page 2 Figure 1 labels Enecom Hiroshima DC and page 5 assigns Enecom provision of the regional data center. Supporting existing-operation context; exact August start day and original opening date unknown. National schematic is not property geometry.

sources.title: Enecom company locations: Hiroshima ICT Center in Enecom Hiroshima Building
sources.summary: Current operator page places Hiroshima ICT Center in Enecom Hiroshima Building at Hiroshima East ward Futabanosato 3-5-1. It separately lists Otemachi headquarters and the Ekikita office at Futabanosato 3-5-7. Address supports named-property linkage, not a published DC coordinate.

sources.title: Hiroshima Data Center service page reached from former EneWings URL
sources.summary: Exact former service URL recorded by the OSM data-center node returns 301 to this current Hiroshima DC page. Current page names Hiroshima DC, East ward location, service operations center and managed entry. No website retrieval date is treated as a new status event; rack ratings are not selected power.
sources.capture_note: Hash covers exact final operator response body. Redirect metadata is separately saved in the local capture record; source URL is the final canonical service page.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap data-center node 12514280890 associated with Enecom
sources.summary: Original OSM API node version 6 gives WGS84 point [132.4758742, 34.4005909], operator Enecom, telecom=data_center and the former EneWings service URL. Community-mapped facility locator; mapping edit date is not facility status or measured coordinate accuracy.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap named Enecom Hiroshima Building way 1025347627
sources.summary: Original OSM way version 1 names Enecom Hiroshima Building and includes its complete ring nodes. The selected data-center node lies inside this ring. Parent-building containment corroborates named-property identity; no surveyed boundary or data-hall footprint selected.
